condition.narrative: The Recipient shall appoint by not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, or any later date as agreed by theAssociation, and thereafter maintain at all time during the implementation of the Program, an independent verification agent withexperience and qualifications and under terms of reference acceptable to the Association.

The Recipient shall carry out the Program in accordance with the Implementation Arrangements set out in Section I, Schedule 2 ofthe Financing Agreement (FA). The Recipient may withdraw the proceeds of the Financing in accordance with Section IV of Schedule 2to this Agreement, and Schedule 4 to the Financing Agreement.

The Recipient shall establish by not later than one (1) month, or any later date as agreed by the Association, after the EffectiveDate and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Program a steering committee with terms of referenceagreed with the Association
The Recipient shall recruit or appoint not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, a M&E specialist, and anenvironmental and social specialist for the Program Coordination Unit (PCU)

title.narrative: Share of Target Local Governments that achieved the Performance Threshold and received the Performance Based Grant within the PBG Legal Framework

comment.narrative: The LG performance target for 2025 was exceeded. However, the transfer of PBGs, which constitutes the second component of the DLR, was delayed, and the DLR was not met for 2025, resulting in the corresponding disbursement not being processed. For 2026, the interim report indicates that the transfer of PBGs to eligible communes is expected to be completed, and the target is anticipated to be achieved during the year.

The team will continue to monitor contract execution and support measures to close the remaining gap.
